# Use rules

| Category | Meaning | Use recommendations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Brands do not use terms | Non-branding language | Change to a clear and precise alternative. |
| Not used in principle | It is explicitly prohibited by law or is usually subject to a higher risk of compliance | Delete or rewrite; in cases of statutory exception, full and precise description and description should be given |
| Conditional use | The term itself is not necessarily contrary to the law, provided that it can be verified, a clear border or the requisite qualifications are available | Description of basis, origin, scope of application and duration |
| Suggested optimization | Not necessarily illegal, but easily exaggerated, misleading or misleading | For priority read objective, specific and limited expression of fact |
